text: And then the carriage drew up, and Thomas stepped down and opened the door, and a little boy, dressed in black velvet, and with a splendid mop of bright waving hair, jumped out. Every man, woman, and child looked curiously upon him. “He's the Captain over again!” said those of the on-lookers who remembered his father. “He's the Captain's self, to the life!” He stood there in the sunlight looking up at the Earl, as Thomas helped that nobleman out, with the most affectionate interest that could be imagined. The instant he could help, he put out his hand and offered his shoulder as if he had been seven feet high.
